composition_variation: Paint Tony Tony Chopper tucked on a low wooden bench beneath snow-laden cedar branches, wearing his familiar pink hat and a cozy cream knitted scarf. He cradles a small mug of cocoa with both hooves, looking delighted. Use soft pastel storybook rendering, powder-blue snow, strawberry accents, and amber lantern light. Preserve his compact reindeer proportions and cute friendly expression. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
